newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues, distillates higher.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues, distillates higher.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks rose by 1.825 million barrels in the week ending April 9 to 10.054 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks also rose by 633,000 barrels to 5.586 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks rose to their highest level since May 1995 to 7.237 million barrels, up a hefty 855,000 barrels
They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha.
